title: Echo: A multi-agent AI system for patient-centered pharmacovigilance

contributions.purpose: 从患者叙事挖掘药物安全信号
contributions.mechanism: Echo 四智能体(Explorer 挖 Reddit / Analyzer 量化关联 / Verifier 比对 FDA / Proposer 生成假设)
contributions.evaluation: proof-of-concept:<200 条 Reddit 帖抽出 640 条药-症关联,Claude 3.5 Sonnet 作 Explorer 优于基线
contributions.domain: 药物警戒 / 多智能体
contributions.source_quote: Our contributions include: a proof-of-concept where we extract 640 drug–symptom associations from less than 200 Reddit posts, with Claude 3.5 Sonnet outperforming baselines as the Explorer agent

contributions.purpose: 发现 FDA 库缺失的新信号
contributions.evaluation: 5 条 FDA 缺失但患者强报的关联(如 pembrolizumab-白日嗜睡、nivolumab-心包积液)
contributions.source_quote: identifying five associations absent from FDA safety data but strongly reported by patients, including pembrolizumab-linked daytime somnolence and nivolumab-associated pericardial effusion

contributions.purpose: 回溯验证早期预警能力
contributions.evaluation: 定性:Echo 或可在监管认定前数月预示 checkpoint inhibitor pneumonitis 等毒性
contributions.source_quote: demonstrating through pre-2017 case studies that Echo might have anticipated later-recognized events, such as checkpoint inhibitor pneumonitis, months before regulatory updates.

contributions.mechanism: 交互式界面查关联/患者原话/假设
contributions.source_quote: We also present an interactive user interface for exploring associations, evidence, confounders, and generated hypotheses.

notes: 验证性红旗(非造假):640 条关联无临床 ground-truth,Verifier 的"novel"仅指 FDA 缺失而非临床确证;"might have detected"回溯预警属推测;作者自认信号应作"complementary, hypothesis-generating"而非临床证据。样本极小(<200 帖)。Claude Sonnet 3.5 列为作者。checklist AI 参与度 B/C/C/C,声明结果人工核验。accept。
